terms.802.1X: eight oh two point one X

lines.line-2: First, ask whether the network itself requires authentication. On an ordinary network, the laptop can continue toward D H C P. On an eight oh two point one X network, access is conditional.
lines.line-5: That N P S exchange is conditional. In the normal path without eight oh two point one X, the laptop goes from the network to D H C P, then D N S, then the Domain Controller. N P S is not involved in every domain connection.
lines.line-13: So the complete enterprise flow is: if required, eight oh two point one X authentication through the switch or access point and N P S; then network access; D H C P supplies I P, gateway, and D N S; D N S locates the Domain Controller; and the Domain Controller handles domain login and services.
